meta_description:
brenebrown on September 8, 2026: "Aaron Sandel @prof.sandel, an anthropologist and primatologist, has spent over a decade studying the Ngogo chimpanzees, witnessing one of the largest known chimp communities split into two factions.

Aaron helps Adam and I understand what chimpanzees can teach us about friendship, conflict, belonging, and human nature. He shares what he learned from watching these chimps show affection, navigate dominance hierarchies, and face the effects of division within their own community.

Aaron also reflects on what it was like to watch chimps he knew by name turn against one another, while exploring the surprising depth of bonds in this community.

If you’re trying to find me this semester, I’ll be the one sneaking into Aaron’s class at UT Austin! I have so many more questions!

To listen or watch the full episode, head to YouTube or wherever you listen to podcasts.".
